Cheers to all the staff members

We booked Hotel Grand Manor for my son’s naming ceremony on 13th November 2025, and the entire experience was truly wonderful. A special mention goes to Mohit, who coordinated the event with exceptional professionalism. He was proactive, responsive, and made sure everything was taken care well in advance, From planning the layout to guiding us through the menu and decor options, his support made entire process smooth and stress-free.

On the day of the event, everything was exactly as committed. Food was delicious, ambience was warm and elegant, and the music and catering arrangements were fantastic. Mohit ensured event ran seamlessly, and our guests genuinely appreciated us for the venue selection.

Overall, a very satisfying experience. Highly recommended for family functions and celebrations!
